wave_1.description: 无依赖任务，5 个 M 级全部并行。分别修改 3 个 Agent 的 2 份副本（运行时 + 插件）+ 源模板 + 输出模板。
wave_1.strategy: 5 tasks modify independent file groups — plan (2 files), review (2 files), validate (2 files), source templates (3 files), output templates (3 files). Zero overlap in modified files ensures safe parallel execution.

wave_2.description: 依赖 Wave 1 全部完成，4 个 S 级验证任务可并行。含 1 个修改任务（build-agents.cjs 注释）+ 3 个纯验证任务。
wave_2.strategy: TASK-006 modifies build script header comment. TASK-007~009 are pure validation (no file modifications). All 4 can run in parallel after Wave 1 completes.

execution_notes: TASK-004 source template sync can optionally wait for TASK-001~003 to complete first, then apply diffs — this is an efficiency optimization, not a hard dependency
TASK-001~003 each modify paired plugin+runtime copies; build agent should modify BOTH copies within the same task execution to avoid desync
Wave 2 S-level tasks can be batched: @sddu-build TASK-006~009
FR-013/FR-014 (backward compatibility) are implicitly handled by the review/validate template rewrites — old-format plan.md §8/§9 will be ignored by the new autonomous agents
